exposure: step-wise surgical technique of knapsack-like uterine compression sutures
cohort: The study included 34 patients diagnosed with intractable postpartum hemorrhage during cesarean section due to severe uterine atony and placental factors.
finding: The new uterine compression suture successfully stopped bleeding in 33 out of 34 patients, achieving an effective rate of 97.06%.
mod_finding: The step-wise surgical technique of knapsack-like uterine compression sutures proved highly effective and safe for treating intractable postpartum hemorrhage specifically during cesarean sections.
